title: Close Window targets a never-created name
description: Error-prone rule — a Close Window step targets a window name that no New Window, Go to Related Record or Set Window Title step ever produces anywhere in the imported solution. Such a close is a silent no-op: the window it was meant to clean up stays open on every execution path.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Close Window by name only works when some step actually creates or renames a window to that exact name. A close that references a name never produced is dead cleanup — typically a leftover after a rename, or a New Window whose name option was never filled in. The opened window then leaks and, on FileMaker Server, a leaked window can silently take over the found set of the calling loop.
rule.remediation: Give the window-opening step (New Window, or Go to Related Record with the New-window option) the exact name the Close Window step targets — or close by Current Window right where the window goes out of scope.
